::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Thane-based sensor company (hydrogen detection and platform gas sensors) moving into a companion CMOS analog front-end SoC under DLI.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Gas sensors and a CMOS data-acquisition analog front-end SoC to read them out.
